notes: The test machine restarted between 19:39 and 20:00 UTC on 2026-11-17. The payer and watchtower nodes were down for at most about 20 minutes around minute 250, when the force close was due; the payer force-closed about 90 seconds after it came back (block time 20:02:08 UTC). The LSP node was not restarted.

The watchtower's settlement transaction took the commitment cell from 1099.99999543 to 899.99999543 CKB; the 200 CKB TLC went to the watchtower's own lock in an output of 499.99999086 CKB that also carries the watchtower's own fee input.
